declarative.why: an expression over $user; false hides the screen and its navigation entry

notLower.why: hiding a nav entry and showing 'not available' is shell behaviour the platform owns; it is a convenience, never security -- the server still enforces access on every call

twice.note: ride-hailing `drivers-board` ($user.roles.contains('DISPATCHER')) and dsl-conformance-max `place-order` ($user.roles.contains('WAREHOUSEMANAGER')); both added 2026-11-18. Roles reach the client UPPER-CASED.

enforced.note: ExperienceValidationTest rejects an expression that does not parse; core.js isVisible is covered by experience-client.test.mjs. Neither app asserts a screen being HIDDEN: both expressions are true for the role the experience is for, so the proof is that the screen stays reachable (dsl-conformance-max probe 19: 4 screens; ride-hailing experience stage). It is UI only and deliberately not a security control.
